name: frameplan_layout_then_edit
description: Q-13: moving a node saves its placement with set_layout, which is a commit of the rendering document like any other and moves its digest. The panel that edits next must send the new digest. On the fixture, a node dragged in the Graph tab is followed by New render target... on the Frame Plan; on a Blank pipeline project, the Frame Plan's own present node is dragged and Add material pass... -- on Blank's graph root the Graph's palette (GL-5c) -- > deferred_geometry_v1 > OK then makes the pass in the graph's nodes, with the digest the placement left (it used to be refused as external_modification until the project was opened again).
